key_insight: Inserting an ultrathin high work-function metal layer between ITO and NiOx lowers the hole-injection barrier and significantly boosts perovskite LED luminance.
engineering_relevance: This offers a simple, scalable anode-interface modification strategy to improve charge injection and brightness in all-inorganic PeLEDs without changing the core device stack.
method: Simulated the device using drift-diffusion and Poisson equations in Setfos.
Added a ~2 nm transition metal layer at the ITO/NiOx interface.
Compared high work-function metals including Au, Pd, and Pt.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that 2 nm Au increased luminance by more than 18× in simulation, with similar improvement trends for Pd and Pt.
watch_item: The result is simulation-based, so experimental validation is still needed to confirm real-device performance and process compatibility.
paper_title: Boosting Perovskite Light-Emitting Diodes Performance by Introducing High Work-function Metal Transition Layer
